prior_visibility: D068-D077 profiles, relative registration curves, and WLC metadata provenance are known. No atomic or telluric line centroids, depths, inter-order anchor velocity offsets, or RV-aligned 5-epoch coadds have been computed or inspected on these FEROS profiles prior to this lock. Laboratory air wavelengths and Gaia DR3 systemic RV prior (+33.84 +- 0.45 km/s) were selected purely from external spectroscopic databases (NIST ASD / VALD / Sousa-Neves HARPS FGK list / HITRAN / Gaia DR3).

locked_anchors10.caution_note: Strong K-dwarf Mn I resonance-multiplet line; excluded from primary clean RV mean due to hyperfine-structure broadening, retained as full diagnostic anchor.
Ionized Cr II multiplet 30 transition; weaker/blended in cool K-dwarfs, retained with explicit depth classification.
Standard FGK abundance/RV Ni I line in HDU 17.
Neutral vanadium line enhanced in cool K-dwarfs (BLUE sideband of 0071; covers HDU 24 & 25).
Benchmark isolated HARPS FGK Fe I line (Sousa/Neves list; RED sideband of 0071; covers HDU 24 & 25).
Secondary isolated Fe I line 0.534 A redward of 5731.762 A (covers HDU 24 & 25).
Strong benchmark isolated Fe I line in BLUE sideband of 0061 (covers HDU 29 & 30).
Low-excitation (0.99 eV, log gf ~ -5.79) weak Fe I line in RED sideband of 0061; tests weak stellar component inside RED mask.
Atmospheric water vapor line in BLUE sideband of 0061; stationary at topocentric v_topo ~ 0 km/s (barycentric v_bary ~ +BARYCORR).
Prominent atmospheric water vapor line inside RED sideband [6551.10, 6554.10] A of 0061; tests atmospheric pull on D075/D076 RED-sideband shifts.

deterministic_anchor_estimator.relativity_convention: Exact special-relativistic rapidity: eta_bary = atanh(v_bary / c), lambda_bary = lambda_lab_air * exp(eta_bary); for telluric lines eta_bary = atanh(BARYCORR / c) + atanh(v_topo / c). Zero double BARYCORR application.
deterministic_anchor_estimator.linear_model: y(lambda) = c0 + c1*(lambda - lambda_exp) - d * exp(-0.5 * (c*tanh(ln(lambda/lambda_c)) / sigma_v)^2); exact linear least squares at each of 401 grid velocities.
deterministic_anchor_estimator.subgrid_refinement: Closed-form 5-point orthogonal-polynomial parabola on SSE[best-2 : best+3] when 2 <= best <= 398, positive absorption depth d > 0 across stencil, and quadratic curvature a2 > 0.

quality_tiers.STRONG_CLEAN_ABSORPTION: c0 > 0, relative_depth = d/c0 >= 0.08, not on grid boundary (0 or 400)
quality_tiers.WEAK_OR_SHALLOW_ABSORPTION: c0 > 0, 0 < relative_depth < 0.08, not on grid boundary
quality_tiers.BOUNDARY_OR_NONABSORPTION_RETAINED: d <= 0 across grid, c0 <= 0, or best index at grid boundary 0/400 (retained explicitly, never dropped)

cohesive_study_parts: Part 1: All 810 profile-anchor measurements across 240 D071 profiles (5 epochs x 3 modes x flat/nonflat x covering HDUs).

Part 2: Direct inter-order stellar wavelength offset (HDU 30-29 at 0061, HDU 25-24 at 0071, HDU 17-0 control at 0063), point-by-point order flux-ratio tilt, and quantitative test of telluric H2O vs stellar Fe I pull on D075/D076 RED-BLUE sideband shifts at 0061.

Part 3: Empirical FEROS stellar rest-frame RV per epoch (F1-F5), rest-frame air wavelengths of D002-0061/0063/0071, and 5-epoch coadded + per-epoch contrast check across all 6 D068 background models (unshifted barycentric and empirical-RV-aligned).

Part 4: Complete cross-instrument synthesis of HD 43629 (HARPS 2021 D002-D064 + FEROS 2019 D065-D078) with normalized tables and byte-exact preservation of the D077 107,105-cell historical state snapshot.
table_schema_policy: Preserve D077 ALL37_INTERPRETATION.csv and FULL_SAMPLE_STATE141.csv byte-for-byte at 107,105 cells without appending sparse extra columns to unrelated stars; publish D078 outputs as clean normalized JSON/CSV tables.
